name: Koikatsu Party
summary: Anime-styled 3D character creator, dating sim, and CharaStudio scene poser with official Steam VR module support and enormous community card libraries.
ranking_rationale: Unrivaled anime character card sharing and CharaStudio posing power, even though Steam's version ships censored without Illusion's official external patch.

pricing.notes: Base edition on Steam (requires official free Special Patch externally to restore uncut adult & VR features).

pros: Deepest anime 3D character customization and shareable PNG character cards
CharaStudio mode enables custom pose, lighting, and animated scene authoring
Dedicated VR mode supported on PCVR headsets
cons: Steep Western Steam price tag plus required external uncensor patch
Community modpacks (HF Patch) nearly mandatory for full western QoL
